11310-hindu-tales-from-the-sanskrit.creator: Unknown

Hindu children become familiar at their mothers’ knees with these stories, and are trained to answer questions on them, subtly chosen to suit their ages and call into action their mental faculties. 12945-the-boy-scouts-of-the-geological-s.title: The Boy Scouts Of The Geological Survey
12945-the-boy-scouts-of-the-geological-s.creator: Scout Master Robert Shaler
12945-the-boy-scouts-of-the-geological-s.description: A book by Scout Master Robert Shaler. Ralph felt that it was high time that he brought to a close his season's operations with trap and gun. The spring was unusually early this year, and the fallow truck patches were fairly clamoring for his attention. Yet he was reluctant to abandon his winter pursuit of pelts and to return to the sterner and less thrilling labor of ploughing and planting and peddling vegetables.

35256-your-negro-neighbor.title: Negro Neighbor
35256-your-negro-neighbor.creator: Benjamin Brawley
35256-your-negro-neighbor.description: A book by Benjamin Brawley. in the history of mankind. Already our sons and brothers have died in Europe. While the sacrifice is great, and each day comes home more closely to us, there must be no ceasing of the conflict until victory is assured. The principles of Christ must prevail, and democracy must be given some chance in the world.

arxiv-1904-07885.title: Matter Chern Simons Theories in a Background Magnetic Field
arxiv-1904-07885.creator: Indranil Halder, Shiraz Minwalla
arxiv-1904-07885.description: Abstract We study large N \displaystyle N 2+1 dimensional fermions in the fundamental representation of an S ​ U ​ ( N ) k \displaystyle SU(N)_{k} Chern Simons gauge group in the presence of a uniform background magnetic field for the U ⁡ ( 1 ) \displaystyle U(1) global symmetry of this theory.

arxiv-2308-14226.title: О про- p p -группах с одним определяющим соотношением
arxiv-2308-14226.creator: А. Ф. Красников
arxiv-2308-14226.description: Abstract Введение Известная теорема о свободе Магнуса [ 1 ] показывает, что если F — свободная группа с базой x_{1},\ldots,x_{n} , H=\textup{\T2A\cyrg\T2A\cyrr }(x_{1},\ldots,x_{n-1}) , r\in F — циклически несократимое слово в образующих x_{1},\ldots,x_{n} , содержащее x_{n} , R — нормальная подгруппа, порожденная в группе F элементом r , то H\cap R=1 .

arxiv-2311-09796.title: Interpreting User Requests in the Context of Natural Language Standing Instructions
arxiv-2311-09796.creator: Nikita Moghe, Patrick Xia, Jacob Andreas, Jason Eisner Benjamin Van Durme Harsh Jhamtani
arxiv-2311-09796.description: Abstract Users of natural language interfaces, frequently powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), must often repeat their full set of preferences each time they make a similar request. We describe an approach to LLM-based dialogue modeling in which persistent user constraints and preferences – collectively termed standing instructions – are provided as additional context for such interfaces.

arxiv-2402-01881.title: AgentHPO: Large Language Model Agent for Hyper-Parameter Optimization
arxiv-2402-01881.creator: Siyi Liu, Chen Gao, Yong Li
arxiv-2402-01881.description: Abstract Hyperparameter optimization is critical in modern machine learning, requiring expert knowledge, numerous trials, and high computational and human resources. Despite the advancements in Automated Machine Learning (AutoML), challenges in terms of trial efficiency, setup complexity, and interoperability still persist.

arxiv-2411-08617.title: Globally Stable Dark Energy in F ⁡ ( R ) F(R) Gravity
arxiv-2411-08617.creator: Hua Chen
arxiv-2411-08617.description: Abstract F ⁡ ( R ) F(R) models for dark energy generally exhibit a weak curvature singularity, which can be cured by adding an R 2 R^{2} term. This correction allows for a unified description of primordial and late-time accelerated expansions.

arxiv-2412-10923.title: Linear Programming based Approximation to Individually Fair k-Clustering with Outliers
arxiv-2412-10923.creator: Binita Maity ∗, Shrutimoy Das ∗, Anirban Dasgupta
arxiv-2412-10923.description: Abstract Individual fairness guarantees are often desirable properties to have, but they become hard to formalize when the dataset contains outliers. Here, we investigate the problem of developing an individually fair k k -means clustering algorithm for datasets that contain outliers.

arxiv-2503-24242.title: Orlando’s flask: detection of a lost-and-found valley on the Moon
arxiv-2503-24242.creator: Vito Squicciarini, Irina Mirova (Ирина Мирова), Francis D. Anderson,, Zhiyuan He (和智远 ), Wahmān al-Khwārizmī (وَهْمَان الخوارزمي )
arxiv-2503-24242.description: Abstract High angular resolution holds the key to extending our knowledge in several domains of astronomical research. In addition to the development of new instruments, advancements in post-processing algorithms can enhance the performances attainable in an observation, turning archival observations into a treasure.

arxiv-2509-00581.title: SQL-of-Thought: Multi-agentic Text-to-SQL with Guided Error Correction
arxiv-2509-00581.creator: Saumya Chaturvedi, Aman Chadha, Laurent Bindschaedler
arxiv-2509-00581.description: Abstract Converting natural language queries into SQL queries is a crucial challenge in both industry and academia, aiming to increase access to databases and large-scale applications. This work examines how in-context learning and chain-of-thought can be utilized to develop a robust solution for text-to-SQL systems.

arxiv-2512-03940.title: Capture into Apsidal Resonance and the Decimation of Planets around In-spiraling Binaries
arxiv-2512-03940.creator: Mohammad Farhat, Jihad Touma
arxiv-2512-03940.description: Abstract Transiting circumbinary planets (CBPs) are conspicuously rare, and entirely absent around stellar binaries with periods ≤ 7 ​ days \leq 7~{\rm days} . Here, we exploit a secular resonance to stimulate the orbit of a CBP into strong, disruptive interactions with the host binary.

arxiv-2602-06381.title: HyQuRP: Hybrid quantum-classical neural network with rotational and permutational equivariance for 3D point clouds
arxiv-2602-06381.creator: Semin Park, Chae-Yeun Park
arxiv-2602-06381.description: Abstract We introduce HyQuRP, a hybrid quantum-classical neural network equivariant to rotational and permutational symmetries. While existing equivariant quantum machine learning models often rely on ad hoc constructions, HyQuRP is built upon the formal foundations of group representation theory. In the sparse-point regime, HyQuRP consistently outperforms strong classical and quantum baselines across multiple benchmarks.

pmc-10500810.title: Efficacy of high-fidelity simulation in advanced life support training: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-10500810.creator: Qin Zeng, Kai Wang, Wei-xin Liu, Jiu-zhi Zeng, Xing-lan Li, Qing-feng Zhang, Shang-qing Ren, Wen-ming Xu
pmc-10500810.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundSimulation is an increasingly used novel method for the education of medical professionals. This study aimed to systematically review the efficacy of high-fidelity (HF) simulation compared with low-fidelity (LF) simulation or no simulation in advanced life support (ALS) training.MethodsA comprehensive search of the PubMed, Chinese Biomedicine Database, Embase, CENTRAL, ISI, and China Knowledge Resource Integrated Database was performed to identify randomized controlled trials (RCTs) that evaluated the use of HF simulation in ALS training.

pmc-10555184.title: THU251 Diagnostic Performance For Predicting Hepatic And Peripheral Tissue Insulin Resistance In Young Adult Men Using 1Hour Post Load Serum Glucose And Insulin Levels A Pilot Study
pmc-10555184.creator: Andrés Julian Ledezma, Cristian Felipe Espinel Pachón, Sussan sthefany Perea, Jorge Eduardo Caminos
pmc-10555184.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Espinel Pachón: None. Caminos: None.Insulin resistance (RI) is a risk factor for prediabetes and DM2, and other non communicable diseases. Different studies have demonstrated that 1h post load serum glucose levels during an oral glucose test tolerance OGTT seem to be a better predictor of peripheral RI than 2h post load serum glucose among individuals without DM2. On the other hand, HOMA IR reflects primarily hepatic sensitivity/resistance, meanwhile, Matsuda index, may reflect both hepatic and peripheral tissue insulin sensitivity/resistance.

pmc-11435135.title: Diagnosis of Prostate Cancer with a Neurotensin–Bombesin Radioligand Combination—First Preclinical Results
pmc-11435135.creator: Maria Bibika, Panagiotis Kanellopoulos, Maritina Rouchota, George Loudos, Berthold A. Nock, Eric P. Krenning, Theodosia Maina
pmc-11435135.description: Background: The concept of radiotheranostics relies on the overexpression of a biomolecular target on malignant cells to direct diagnostic/therapeutic radionuclide-carriers specifically to cancer lesions. The concomitant expression of more than one target in pathological lesions may be elegantly exploited to improve diagnostic sensitivity and therapeutic efficacy.

pmc-11454866.title: 9268 The Pro-atrophic Effect of Vitamin D Binding Protein in Skeletal Muscle and Its Involvement in Cancer-Induced Muscle Wasting
pmc-11454866.creator: Nicoletta Filigheddu, Tommaso Raiteri, Simone Reano, Andrea Scircoli, Alessandro Antonioli, Flavia Prodam
pmc-11454866.description: Disclosure: N. Filigheddu: None. T. Raiteri: None. S. Reano: None. A. Scircoli: None. A. Antonioli: None. F. Prodam: None.Vitamin D binding protein (VDBP), encoded by the Gc gene, is a multifunctional serum glycoprotein synthesized by hepatocytes, whose primary function is the transport of vitamin D metabolites in the bloodstream.

pmc-11584921.title: COVID-19 Pandemic Coping, Social Support, and Emotional Health in American Indian and Alaska Native Peoples
pmc-11584921.creator: Cole Haskins, Carolyn Noonan, Ann Collier, Richard MacLehose, Dedra Buchwald, Spero M. Manson
pmc-11584921.description: This cross-sectional study investigates associations of coping behaviors and social support with emotional health among American Indian and Alaska Native individuals during the COVID-19 pandemic. Introduction The COVID-19 pandemic placed a burden on the physical and emotional well-being of all people, including American Indian and Alaska Native communities.

pmc-11673416.title: Geographic Variation in Signal Preferences in the Tropical Katydid Neoconocephalus triops
pmc-11673416.creator: Oliver M Beckers, Johannes Schul, Leon G Higley
pmc-11673416.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryMany animals communicate to bring the sexes together for reproduction. However, only if male signals and female preferences match, communication will lead to reproduction. Despite this required match between preferences and signals, animal communication systems evolve rapidly. The processes for how a system with a tight match between signal and preference acquires the variation necessary for evolution to proceed are poorly understood and are the focus of this study.

pmc-12424167.title: Amphiphilic Protein Surfactants Reduce the Interfacial Tension of Biomolecular Condensates
pmc-12424167.creator: Bruna Favetta, Huan Wang, Zheng Shi, Benjamin S. Schuster
pmc-12424167.description: Biomolecular condensates are protein-dense regions in cells that often arise from liquid–liquid phase separation. Interfacial tension is a key determinant of biomolecular condensate behavior, influencing condensate size and interactions with intracellular structures. Certain proteins and RNAs are known to selectively localize to the interface of condensates, where they can regulate condensate function in cells.

pmc-12540979.title: Assessing genetic gain and diversity in Ethiopian bread wheat across six decades
pmc-12540979.creator: Sefawdin Berta, Temesgen Matiwos Menamo, Zerihun Tadesse, Techale Birhan, Abush Tesfaye Abebe
pmc-12540979.description: Assessing breeding progress and genetic diversity in released varieties is crucial for informing future crop improvement strategies. This study evaluated genetic gain and diversity in 49 Ethiopian wheat varieties released over six decades (1967–2021). Significant yield increases were observed, with ‘Shaki’ showing the highest gain. However, the average annual genetic gain was modest (0.90% under irrigated, 0.69% under rain-fed).

pmc-12590938.title: Students' relationship quality in class: Exploring latent profiles, latent transitions and links to student motivation
pmc-12590938.creator: Juliane Schlesier, Ramona Obermeier, Michaela Gläser‐Zikuda
pmc-12590938.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundEarly secondary school students' perceptions of their social relationships in class are closely linked to their levels of motivation. However, person‐centred research examining patterns of social relationships with both peers and teachers remains limited.AimsThis study explored the existence, stability and transitions of latent profiles of students' social relationships over time, as well as their interconnectedness with students' motivation, gender, immigration background and educational track.Sample(s)The sample included 1343 5th grade students (first year after transitioning to secondary school), assessed at three time measurement

pmc-12811220.title: Is Reference a Relation of Equivalence or Sameness?
pmc-12811220.creator: Elberto A Plazas
pmc-12811220.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The stimulus equivalence (SE) paradigm has become a central explanatory framework for language and complex symbolic behavior within behavior analysis. Its explanatory power rests on three core assumptions: (1) human symbolic behavior is grounded in the semantic relation between words and their referents; (2) this relation is one of equivalence; and in consequence (3) there is a transfer of stimulus functions between words and their referents.

pmc-13463848.title: Mild Hyperbaric Oxygen Exposure Is Associated with Calculation-Method-Dependent Changes in VE/VCO2 During Seated Rest
pmc-13463848.creator: Takehira Nakao, Toru Hirata, Atsushi Saito
pmc-13463848.description: Simple SummaryIt is not fully understood how respiratory patterns at rest change in an environment with slightly higher atmospheric pressure and oxygen concentration, despite the increased supply of oxygen to the body. In this study, we investigated changes in respiration and carbon dioxide output in 16 healthy young men whilst they were sitting at rest in such an environment.

pmc-13656675.title: Mental health screening in women with polycystic ovary syndrome: protocol for a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13656675.creator: Rajalakshmi Rajendran, Marva Abdul Khader, Priya Shivanna, Prathiksha M. Shet, Niyam Hegde, Deeya Karkera, Girish Thunga
pmc-13656675.description: BackgroundPolycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a common endocrine disorder affecting women of reproductive age and is reported frequently with mental health disorders. This systematic review aims to synthesize the available evidence on mental health screening and its potential role in identifying and addressing mental health conditions among women with PCOS.

pmc-13700334.title: Use of hair relaxers and hair dyes during pregnancy and breast tissue composition in mothers and adolescent daughters
pmc-13700334.creator: Marissa Chan, Lothar Lilge, Jane Walter, Parisa Tehranifar, Rachel L. Miller, Anhthu Hoang, Peggy Shephard, Frederica Perera, Julie B. Herbstman, Mary Beth Terry, Jasmine A. McDonald, Rebecca D. Kehm
pmc-13700334.description: BackgroundBlack and Hispanic women are more likely to present with advanced-stage breast cancer and have lower survival rates compared to white women. Hair products are a source of exposure to environmental chemicals (e.g., formaldehyde, phthalates) that may contribute to these persistent inequities, particularly when used during sensitive exposure windows for breast tissue development (i.e., pregnancy, gestation).
